layouts.name: Circuit des Remparts
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Reviewed the organizer’s 2024 historic-course plan: Rempart Desaix and Avenue des Maréchaux lead through the Théâtre/Carnot turn, Rue Louis Desbrandes, Rue Waldeck Rousseau, the full Marronnier return on Rue du Colonel Driant, Rue de Verdun and the Cathédrale turn. Retains the pinned unnamed street connection at the southern Carnot turn and the short Avenue du Président Wilson connection at the cathedral; excludes the internal Driant shortcut and the unrelated Rempart du Midi. All vertices and joins use exact independent road-map nodes. The 1303.4 m public-road centerline differs from the 1271 m timing distance; temporary race barriers, hairpin placement and the mapped underpass junction remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1303.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
